# R447 — feature/sycl と個人 fork main の非推論機能差分調査

日付: 2026-10-14 (Asia/Tokyo)

## 範囲と固定した入力

依頼された読み取り専用調査。対象は個人 fork の `/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl` (`feature/sycl`, `4fa478f50f8da396e651e3ae862f8b1849d49b54`) と `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata` の `main` (`beddab2fd6b61631d73b39b7484bc9a585ebe1de`) の tree 差分。唯一の upstream は Niko1221/Strata。対象 SHA は固定され、upstream remote/fetch/最新性の確認はしていない。共通祖先として指定された `d988955e141190bc079b58ab3d3038da637ad070` から両側を別々に比較し、加えて feature/sycl→main の直接 tree 差分を確認した。XeStrata はこの調査で使っていない。

指定された AGENTS.md、`.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync/SKILL.md`、同 skill の `references/integration.md`、R443–R446 の報告を読んだ。working tree は開始時から `AGENTS.md` modified、`.agents/` と `.claude/` untracked だった。変更しなかった。`report-registry-v200.json` は指定された tuning subtree 内で見つからなかった。

`git diff --stat/name-status`, 指定SHAの `git show` とソース内記号・説明を使用。build、test、GPU、環境値/process、fetch、branch作成、source/Git mutation は行っていない。本ファイルだけが調査記録の書き込み。機能の同等性は、似た名前のファイルの存在だけで確定せず、ここでソースを追えなかった行は「未確認」と明示する。

## 全体像

main は ancestor から `serve/server.py`, `serve/frontend.py`, `setup.py`, `src/program/generate.cpp`, CMake、共通core/API、Web、tools/tests、文書を更新している。feature/sycl も独自に CMake、SYCL runtime/kernel/prefill、core、generator、Web/setup/tests を大きく更新している。両側の変更量の大部分は異なる GPU backend とその測定資料だが、main の非推論機能も機械的な merge では拾えない。特に generator は server protocol と共通 core の入口で、main は同ファイルに機能追加とCUDA/HIP固有実装を混在させている。

main で新設・変更が明瞭な機能群は以下。これらは現行 main tree に存在する機能であり、機能の出自が必ずNiko upstreamとは限らない。main および指定祖先間の fork 内差である。

NVIDIA/AMD/CUDA/HIP claims are out of target. Main deletes feature-specific SYCL evidence docs and `docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md`; restore/retain feature docs/policy while reconciling shared docs. |

### Web/API scope and limits

`serve/server.py` on main documents and implements `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`, `/v1/responses`, model/props/slots/health/MCP, optional vision, stream and nonstream responses, request metrics, restart/error tracking, optional batching, runtime control and security checks. New `responses.py` owns response conversion/streaming details; `runconfig.py` owns config logic. `serve/test_responses.py`, `test_runconfig.py`, `test_parallel.py`, `test_vram.py` are direct feature test leads. Existing `test_server.py`, `test_security.py`, `test_monitor.py` were also changed. Feature's raw diff has only changed `serve/server.py`, `frontend.py`, test monitor/server/security and web files; no `responses.py`, `runconfig.py`, `test_responses.py`, `test_parallel.py`, or `test_vram.py` exists in the feature-only added path list. This establishes missing dedicated modules/tests by path, not definitive absence of partial equivalent behavior.

Server must use the feature branch's engine boundary. main's batching is coupled to protocol changes in `generate.cpp`; Responses is service-level and likely can adapt without changing inference; runconfig/VRAM commands depend on backend capabilities and have to preserve busy-state/error behavior when unsupported. API feature parity tests should run against the feature engine or a mock and be added before declaring parity.

## CLI and engine-facing API function inventory

The following are separately reviewable. "Required" here means non-inference functionality under the project skill, with backend-specific feature status handled individually; it does not declare implementation compatibility.

| main behavior | classification | destination/dependency plan | validation correspondence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--batch`, alias `--slots`, `--batch-groups`; `--trim-stage-weights`; BGEN/BSTOP/BYIELD control contract | Required capability; engine API + server scheduler | Port or adapt command grammar, per-slot state, fairness, cancellation, early close, batch group limits to SYCL `generate.cpp` + `serve/server.py`; do not graft CUDA engine structures. | `serve/test_parallel.py`; batch/interleave/early-close tools; service protocol errors. |
| `--tail-role-token` and checkpoint placement around trailing role turn | Required server/prompt-cache behavior | Map to feature conversation cache/snapshot checkpoint calculation. | conversation snapshot tests plus server multi-turn cached prompt test. |
| `--expert-cache-deviceN N|auto`, `--remote-expert-opt` | Required control/capacity behavior if multi-device/remote-expert feature is supported by target; engine/cache bound | Review current feature peer/cache APIs. Adapt portable capacity selection, preserve explicit unsupported condition if only one device; remote optimization's algorithm is optional backend implementation and not copied from `.cu`. | core cache source tests, setup remote option tests, multi-device capability tests. |
| `--vram-elastic`, `--vram-segment-mib`, runtime `VRAM` command | Backend-dependent; CUDA VMM implementation is CUDA-only, request to relinquish/reacquire memory is general API only if SYCL allocator can safely do so | Keep API with capability error or implement through SYCL allocator after lifetime review; never transplant CUDA segment API. | vram route tests cover idle/busy/error; SYCL allocator/session ownership tests needed for implementation (not run). |
| Linux disk diagnostics, VRAM free note, layer split validation | Diagnostic / error-contract | Port relevant error facts through SYCL allocator/PLE and platform abstractions. No inference algorithm replacement. | error-message tests should cover supported failures; existing tests not fully mapped. |
| Older CPU ISA floor build and startup diagnostics | Setup/build compatibility | Treat as separate optional target platform function; CMake/ggml CPU feature set must match actual SYCL build and CPU runtime checks. | `tools/test_setup_oldcpu.py`, `test_setup_older_gpus.py`, no-GPU setup suite. |
| Additional core cache/source fields, conversation snapshot state | Mixed inference storage and public session semantics | Preserve behavior and schema semantics, re-express against feature structures; do not wholesale swap `src/core/*.cpp`. | `conversation_snapshot_test`, `conversation_state`, expert cache/source tests. |

## File and test path changes relevant to integration

main's ancestor delta (not a list of everything edited) includes:

- `serve/responses.py`, `serve/runconfig.py`, and focused response/runconfig/parallel/VRAM tests as new files; server/frontend/security/monitor tests changed.
- `tools/batch_test.py`, `batch_interleave_test.py`, `early_close_test.py`, `parking_test.py`, `conversation_restore_speed.py`, and profile/draft-vocab tools/tests added or updated.
- `src/program/generate.cpp` and CMake changed; `src/core/remote_expert_opt.cu` and `include/strata/core/remote_expert_opt.hpp` added; segmented cache test added; expert source/cache/session/verify/pinned/core files changed.
- `setup.py`, setup golden JSON/test and many setup cases changed; docs added/updated.
- Main's `CMakeLists.txt` removes feature's `STRATA_ENABLE_SYCL` integration and selects separate `sycl/` experimental subproject; feature branch's `src/sycl`, `src/kernels/sycl`, `src/prefill/sycl`, and SYCL tests/tools are absent from main. This is a backend tree decision, not evidence that SYCL engine functions should be deleted from feature. Preserve feature backend selection and tuned inference source.

Test status: none run (read-only restriction). Source-to-test mapping above is intended for the implementing Main to run serially after integration. Setup tests are specifically documented by AGENTS as no-GPU/no-download tests. Server tests can be run with MockEngine; batch tests should cover engine protocol semantics and cannot be considered satisfied by API shape tests alone.

## Adoption priority and explicit non-equivalence

1. First integrate service-level API semantics that do not require engine algorithm changes: Responses API, structured error/stream conversion, runconfig data validation, UI controls, docs and focused tests. Keep the existing feature tokenization/template/engine APIs and adapt at their edges.
2. Then reconcile portable CLI/server behavior: tail-role checkpoint semantics, request lifecycle, metrics definition, batch API only after a SYCL slot/concurrency capability exists, and setup/user-visible options. Each gets dedicated source and regression-test mapping.
3. Reconcile core/session/cache contracts before pulling code: snapshot schema/restore compatibility, segmented cache/remote placement, and VRAM capacity. Preserve the feature branch's current tuned prefill/decode/kernel dispatch, queues, device lifetime and tested storage layout. CUDA `.cu`/VMM/pinning code is not a SYCL implementation.
4. Keep CUDA/HIP implementation/tests/docs out of the Intel target, but retain portable behavior implemented through shared core/API where applicable. Do not drop a user-facing capability solely because its current implementation is in `generate.cpp` or has a `.cu` file nearby.
5. Restore feature-specific research/retention docs, especially `docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md`, and retain `.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync` per user instructions. Current main tree deletes feature's SYCL operations/implementation/research/status docs; these are not product functions but protect the target branch and research evidence.

“Main feature” above means the feature exists in main. “Absent” is asserted only for dedicated new path/tests where raw name-status confirmed no equivalent added path in feature; semantic equivalence for server/API/core was not exhaustively proven by path names. In particular, do not record parity until request/response/error/lifetime behavior and its tests match. Functional changes in main may be fork-local rather than Niko-originated; this bounded task did not check upstream provenance.
